descriptionChirho: A recognized leader or official in the Jewish or Christian community, used as a quasi-title for members of the Sanhedrin, synagogue leaders, or church overseers.
People of former times, the ancients or forefathers, especially those commended for their faith in salvation history.
Comparative adjective describing someone older or more advanced in years, without reference to an official position.
Feminine comparative referring to older or aged women in the community, distinguished from the masculine institutional elder role.
